jobStory.zh: 当患者需要看医生时，患者希望查看可用医生和时段并预约，以便顺利就诊。
jobStory.en: When a patient needs to see a doctor, they want to view available doctors and timeslots and schedule an appointment to get treated.

pain.zh: 已预约的时段无法被其他患者占用，导致患者无法更改或取消预约。
pain.en: Booked appointment slots cannot be booked by other patients, preventing patients from rescheduling or canceling them.

rootObstacle.en: The system lacks an exclusive locking mechanism for booked slots, allowing resources to be reused.

build.en: Build a function that marks booked slots as immutable.

items.quoteZh: 嗨HN！我运营DocSpring，越来越多的客户通过他们的AI客服使用该产品，当客服遇到故障或令人困惑的错误时，它可能会自行解决或放弃，这样我们就永远收不到相关反馈了。（我一直很……）

pain.zh: AI客服遇到问题后无法有效上报，导致缺陷永远无法被发现和修复。
pain.en: The AI agent cannot effectively report issues when faced with bugs or errors, keeping defects undiscovered and unrepaired.

workaround.zh: 假设客服会直接放弃处理并停止使用该功能。
workaround.en: It is assumed the agent will simply give up and stop using the feature.

rootObstacle.zh: AI客服缺乏直接、自动的方式将遇到的问题反馈给人类支持团队。
rootObstacle.en: The AI agent lacks a direct and automatic way to feedback encountered issues to human support teams.

stopIf.zh: 若测试后邮件未发送至预设地址，则该功能无实际价值。
stopIf.en: If the email is not sent to the preset address after testing, the function has no practical value.

items.quoteZh: 这个问题在HN上经常出现。需要注意的是，若希望获得回复，应以"AskHN:"的形式提交问题。不管怎样，这是我对于订阅制软件未来发展的一些有希望（但无法保证正确）的看法。

jobStory.zh: 当一名独立创始人需要管理客户信息时，他希望用简单的方式整合客户数据，以便高效开展业务。
jobStory.en: When an independent founder needs to manage customer information, he wants to integrate customer data in a simple way to run his business efficiently.

pain.zh: 他在尝试将不同来源的客户数据导入系统时，因格式不统一而无法自动匹配，导致手动处理耗时且容易出错。
pain.en: When trying to import customer data from different sources into the system, he cannot automatically match it due to inconsistent formats, forcing manual process

workaround.zh: 他目前只能逐条复制粘贴数据，或者等待他人帮忙整理，这既慢又依赖他人。
workaround.en: He currently has to copy and paste data manually or wait for others to organize it, which is slow and dependent on others.

rootObstacle.zh: 不同来源的客户数据缺乏统一的标准化结构，导致系统无法自动识别和关联字段。
rootObstacle.en: Customer data from different sources lacks a unified standardized structure, preventing the system from automatically recognizing and associating fields.

build.zh: 开发一个能自动检测常见字段类型并建议对应映射关系的简单规则引擎功能。
build.en: Build a simple rule engine function that can automatically detect common field types and suggest corresponding mapping relationships.

test.zh: 编写三个不同格式的测试数据样本，手动输入后观察系统是否给出合理的映射建议。
test.en: Create three test data samples in different formats, manually input them, and observe whether the system provides reasonable mapping suggestions.

stopIf.zh: 如果系统对任意两个测试数据样本都无法提出有效的映射建议，则该需求无实际价值。
stopIf.en: If the system cannot provide valid mapping suggestions for any two test data samples, then this requirement has no practical value.

whyNow.en: The complaint directly points to a specific pain point in the CRM domain, indicating clear room for improvement.

items.titleZh: 用免费软件运营律师事务所
items.quoteZh: 我真羡慕，也很想做到这一点。我在庞大的法律体系中只是一个小小的齿轮，因此只能使用公司规定的技术栈。Outlook、Word，再加上一堆极其不直观、运行缓慢、漏洞频出且肯定很糟糕的工具。

jobStory.zh: 当一名小型律师事务所的独立经营者，想要自主管理客户信息与案件流程，以便更灵活地开展工作。
jobStory.en: When a solo operator of a small law firm wants to manage client information and case processes independently for greater flexibility.

pain.zh: 在使用Outlook、Word等强制规定的低效工具时，遇到极其不直观、运行缓慢且充满漏洞的问题，导致工作受阻。
pain.en: When using mandated inefficient tools like Outlook and Word, encountering extremely unintuitive, slow, and buggy issues that hinder work.

workaround.zh: 只能被迫使用现有工具，因为无法更换技术栈。
workaround.en: They are forced to use existing tools as they cannot change the technology stack.

rootObstacle.zh: 缺乏能够直接替代现有低效工具、且无需依赖外部系统集成的轻量级客户管理功能。
rootObstacle.en: The lack of a lightweight client management feature that can directly replace existing inefficient tools without relying on external systems integration.

build.zh: 开发一个可导入Outlook联系人数据的简单客户端管理模块，实现基础的客户信息查看与编辑。
build.en: Build a simple client management module that can import Outlook contact data to enable basic client information viewing and editing.

test.zh: 创建一个包含5个测试联系人的Excel文件，导入后验证能否正常显示姓名与电话号码。
test.en: Create an Excel file with 5 test contacts and verify if names and phone numbers can be displayed correctly after import.

stopIf.zh: 导入测试数据后出现格式错乱或数据丢失的情况。
stopIf.en: If formatting errors or data loss occur after importing test data.

whyNow.zh: 现有工具存在明显缺陷，亟需简单解决方案来提升工作效率。
